collection_batches_dispatch_shape.name: collection_batches_dispatch_shape
collection_batches_dispatch_shape.value:
("collection_batches"."dispatched_at" IS NULL) = ("collection_batches"."dispatched_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("collection_batches"."status" IN ('open', 'cancelled') OR "collection_batches"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL)

collection_batches_submit_shape.name: collection_batches_submit_shape
collection_batches_submit_shape.value:
("collection_batches"."submitted_at" IS NULL) = ("collection_batches"."submitted_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("collection_batches"."status" IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'cancelled')) = ("collection_batches"."submitted_at" IS NULL)

collection_batches_reconcile_shape.name: collection_batches_reconcile_shape
collection_batches_reconcile_shape.value:
("collection_batches"."status" IN ('reconciled', 'closed')) = ("collection_batches"."reconciled_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND num_nonnulls("collection_batches"."reconciled_at", "collection_batches"."reconciled_by_user_id", "collection_batches"."expected_cash_centavos",
          "collection_batches"."remitted_cash_centavos", "collection_batches"."difference_centavos", "collection_batches"."variance_kind") IN (0, 6)

collection_batches_variance_consistent.name: collection_batches_variance_consistent
collection_batches_variance_consistent.value:
"collection_batches"."reconciled_at" IS NULL OR (
        "collection_batches"."expected_cash_centavos" >= 0 AND "collection_batches"."remitted_cash_centavos" >= 0
        AND "collection_batches"."difference_centavos" = "collection_batches"."remitted_cash_centavos" - "collection_batches"."expected_cash_centavos"
        AND "collection_batches"."variance_kind" = CASE WHEN "collection_batches"."difference_centavos" = 0 THEN 'balanced'
          WHEN "collection_batches"."difference_centavos" < 0 THEN 'shortage' ELSE 'overage' END
        AND ("collection_batches"."difference_centavos" = 0 OR length(trim(coalesce("collection_batches"."variance_reason", ''))) >= 3))

collection_batches_close_shape.name: collection_batches_close_shape
collection_batches_close_shape.value: ("collection_batches"."status" = 'closed') = ("collection_batches"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("collection_batches"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("collection_batches"."closed_by_user_id" IS NULL)

gcash_submissions_review_shape.name: gcash_submissions_review_shape
gcash_submissions_review_shape.value: ("gcash_submissions"."status" = 'pending') = ("gcash_submissions"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) AND ("gcash_submissions"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) = ("gcash_submissions"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL) AND ("gcash_submissions"."status" = 'rejected') = ("gcash_submissions"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_paid_status_consistent.name: invoices_paid_status_consistent
invoices_paid_status_consistent.value:
"invoices"."status" NOT IN ('unpaid', 'partially_paid', 'paid', 'credited') OR "invoices"."status" = CASE
        WHEN "invoices"."total_centavos" + "invoices"."adjusted_centavos" = 0 AND "invoices"."adjusted_centavos" < 0 THEN 'credited'
        WHEN "invoices"."paid_centavos" = "invoices"."total_centavos" + "invoices"."adjusted_centavos" THEN 'paid'
        WHEN "invoices"."paid_centavos" = 0 THEN 'unpaid'
        ELSE 'partially_paid' END

invoices_void_shape.name: invoices_void_shape
invoices_void_shape.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'void') = ("invoices"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("invoices"."status" <> 'void' OR "invoices"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)

payments_field_collection_shape.name: payments_field_collection_shape
payments_field_collection_shape.value:
("payments"."collection_batch_id" IS NULL) = ("payments"."collector_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("payments"."collection_batch_id" IS NULL OR "payments"."method" IN ('cash', 'cheque'))

payments_gcash_shape.name: payments_gcash_shape
payments_gcash_shape.value: ("payments"."method" = 'gcash') = ("payments"."gcash_submission_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("payments"."method" <> 'gcash' OR "payments"."reference_number" IS NOT NULL)

reconnection_records_assignment_shape.name: reconnection_records_assignment_shape
reconnection_records_assignment_shape.value:
num_nonnulls("reconnection_records"."technician_user_id", "reconnection_records"."assigned_by_user_id", "reconnection_records"."assigned_at") IN (0, 3)
        AND ("reconnection_records"."status" <> 'assigned' OR "reconnection_records"."technician_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

reconnection_records_completion_shape.name: reconnection_records_completion_shape
reconnection_records_completion_shape.value:
("reconnection_records"."status" = 'completed') = (num_nonnulls("reconnection_records"."completion_date", "reconnection_records"."completed_by_user_id", "reconnection_records"."completed_at") = 3)
        AND num_nonnulls("reconnection_records"."completion_date", "reconnection_records"."completed_by_user_id", "reconnection_records"."completed_at") IN (0, 3)
        AND ("reconnection_records"."completion_date" IS NULL OR "reconnection_records"."completion_date" >= "reconnection_records"."request_date")

service_accounts_dates_valid.name: service_accounts_dates_valid
service_accounts_dates_valid.value: ("service_accounts"."activation_date" IS NULL) = ("service_accounts"."billing_start_date" IS NULL) AND ("service_accounts"."billing_start_date" IS NULL OR "service_accounts"."billing_start_date" >= "service_accounts"."activation_date")

service_plans_attributes_positive.name: service_plans_attributes_positive
service_plans_attributes_positive.value: ("service_plans"."speed_mbps" IS NULL OR "service_plans"."speed_mbps" > 0) AND ("service_plans"."channel_count" IS NULL OR "service_plans"."channel_count" > 0)
